newsitem.title: FINLAND: Merita reverses gains after Q1 report.
newsitem.headline: Merita reverses gains after Q1 report.

text.p: Shares in Finnish banking group Merita fell on Wednesday after the group reported first quarter earnings up sharply on the same period last year but feathered with gains from equities sales, brokers said.
"The result wasn't as good as it looked at first," one broker said, after the share reversed early gains.
At 1350/1050, Merita traded at 17.80, down 0.20 markka or more than one percent, but off a low of 17.40, in lively 36 million markka trade. It hit 18.50 earlier, up 0.50 markka.
Brokers said profit-taking after recent gains was also partly to blame for the share's decline.
